detailed_descriptions.en: The Story The mysterious organization known only as "The Helix" is hatching a plan to capture an artifact of great power. The leader of Humanity is missing, presumed dead. The Elves are on the move, capturing territory once again. Tensions are high, all sides need a hero. The future of the planet Web lies in the balance. Carter, a Human peasant from a remote village, is thrust into the center of a conspiracy to create the ultimate weapon: The Perfect Homunculus. The Gameplay Deep combat, inspired by the legends of the character action genre, strikes a delicate balance with exploration and puzzle-solving. Create your own Homunculus to serve as your faithful companion as you fight for your life against artificial machines, malformed creations of wizards long-deceased, and enemies of peace in the land of Web. The World Act 1, set in the Human province of Kaliere, takes Carter through the rebuilt Human capital. In the not-so-distant past, war once gripped these plains, and it threatens to do so once again. Learn the history of Humanity, complete side quests, solve puzzles, and walk away with rewards that unlock your true potential as a warrior.
